Real `cat /proc/asound/cards` output from two machines, captured on 2026-11-10: `cards-nuc-*` from an Intel mini PC (Dante USB module + HDA Intel PCH),
`cards-pi-*` from a Raspberry Pi 4B (no USB audio interface attached). The device names in the tests are the real SDL names from the same machines.
Spacing of the second lines may differ slightly from the raw machine output (it is not used by the matcher).
